name: SmartWoo – AI Product Description & Image Optimizer
author: CoderVex

sections.description:
🚀 SmartWoo supercharges your WooCommerce product listings with AI-generated content and visuals. Using OpenAI’s GPT models and DALL·E image generation, SmartWoo helps store owners save time, boost SEO, and improve conversions with just a few clicks.

✨ Features:

  • ✅ AI-generated product titles, short & full descriptions (up to 3000+ words – available pro version)
  • ✅ Intelligent tone options: Friendly, Professional, SEO-rich (available pro version)
  • ✅ Auto-generate SEO-friendly product tags
  • ✅ One-click featured image generation with DALL·E
  • ✅ Automatic alt text generation for images
  • ✅ Modal-based admin popup UI (no page reloads)
  • ✅ Custom model selection: GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo

🧠 Use Cases:

  • Launching new WooCommerce stores with optimized content
  • Scaling product descriptions for dropshipping
  • Improving low-performing product listings
  • Saving time on bulk product content generation

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com) to generate product descriptions, titles, tags, and images using AI models (ChatGPT and DALL·E).

What data is sent and when:
– When you use the AI content or image generation features, the plugin sends your provided product information (such as product title, description, and prompts) to the OpenAI API.
– For image generation, the text prompt you enter is sent to OpenAI’s DALL·E endpoint.
– For content generation, product details and prompts are sent to OpenAI’s ChatGPT endpoint.

Why this data is sent:
– The data is required to generate relevant product descriptions, titles, tags, and images using OpenAI’s AI models.

Where the data is sent:
– All data is sent securely to OpenAI’s servers at https://api.openai.com.

Under which conditions:
– Data is only sent when you actively use the AI generation features within the plugin.

Service provider:
– OpenAI (https://openai.com)

Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder smartwoo to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SmartWoo to configure your OpenAI API key and preferences
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product and click the “Generate with AI” button to get started
sections.faq:
Does SmartWoo work with all WooCommerce products?

Yes, it works with all simple and variable products.

Can I use my own OpenAI API key?

Yes. You must enter your OpenAI key on the SmartWoo settings page to use the plugin.

Can I disable image generation or alt text features?

Yes. You can toggle these features from the plugin settings.

Does SmartWoo support GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo?

Yes. You can choose your preferred GPT model in the settings.
